what: Mistake: specified cut A's early pull request 'when verification starts' (job 20261025-055626-er96 and its retries) without checking the stage order: Athena's own checks (about 12 minutes) run before verification, so CI got about 2 minutes' head start on a 16-minute run and the first landing after cut A (PR #180) took 18 minutes.
why: A speed change should be checked against the measured stage timeline it relies on (here: producer, then 12-minute checks, then a 2-minute verifier, then landing) before it is requested.
